# call-pele-answer

> Open-source agent skill (Claude Code plugin, also works with OpenAI Codex CLI, Cursor, OpenCode) that turns long AI answers into one-file offline interactive HTML explainer pages. It splits an answer into blocks and picks the best form per block (prose, table, Mermaid flowchart/state/sequence diagram, timeline, slider, tabs, step player, switchable views) instead of using a fixed template. Model writes Markdown only; bundled Node.js CLI `pe` renders. Includes a palette (recolor) and annotations (copy feedback to the agent with block IDs). Router: TypeSafe Jev / System One, free endpoint, or local rules; auto-routes to all 33 Pele/Mermaid diagram types (mindmap, usecase, C4, requirement, eventmodeling, kanban, packet, wardley, cynefin, railroad, …). Runs are logged (runs.jsonl) and `pe stats` gives tuning advice. MIT license. Chinese and English.
